description: Source file implementing control-plane scheduling commands for Open Fronthaul, including message generation for section types 1 and 3, PRACH control, and eCPRI control parameters.

classes.name: data_flow_cplane_scheduling_commands_impl
classes.description: Implementation of control-plane scheduling command handling, including message enqueueing and context management.

methods.name: init_radio_app_header_parameters
methods.description: Initializes radio application header parameters for control messages.

methods.name: init_common_section_0_1_3_5_fields
methods.description: Initializes common fields for control sections of types 0, 1, 3, and 5.

methods.name: generate_section1_control_parameters
methods.description: Generates downlink control parameters for section type 1 based on context.

methods.name: cplane_convert_scs
methods.description: Converts PRACH subcarrier spacing to O-RAN specific value.

methods.name: generate_prach_control_parameters
methods.description: Generates control parameters for PRACH messages.

methods.description: Creates eCPRI real-time control parameters with sequence ID and eAxC.
